method: OpenStreetMap building:part way 1454005510, name 'R55', used verbatim. The enclosing OSM building (way 200338759, R55 plus the smaller R5.x block) carries the mapper's fixme 'R55 is the experimental hall only'; only the R55 part is drawn. The identification R55 = Target Station 1 comes from ISIS's own safety page ('Target Station 1 (R55)').
name: ISIS Target Station 1, building R55 (experimental hall)
notes: The footprint is the whole R55 hall, not the target, moderators or beamlines inside it. The ISIS synchrotron is not drawn (see map.unlocated).

summary.plain: The building that houses ISIS Target Station 1, the first of the facility's two neutron sources, and its experimental hall.
